problem.pollQuestion.note: what keeps a Poll block from working; Send Readiness lists them too

problem.pollTwoAnswers: A poll needs at least two answers.
problem.pollFiveAnswers: A poll takes at most five answers.

problem.pollTags.message: Give every answer a tag, or save the answer to a field.
problem.pollTags.note: the poll saves each answer as a tag on the contact

problem.pollField.message: Pick the field the answer is saved to.

problem.pollSurvey.message: Pick the survey the poll continues to.
problem.pollSurvey.note: after answering, the poll can open a survey

problem.surveyMaxQuestions.message: A survey takes up to {max, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}.

problem.surveyTwoAnswers: A choice question needs at least two answers.

problem.surveyField.message: Pick the field the answer is saved to.

problem.surveyTags.message: Give every answer a tag, or don't save the answer.
problem.surveyTags.note: the question saves each answer as a tag on the contact

problem.surveySlugTaken.message: Another survey of this workspace has that address. Pick another.

problem.surveyIncomplete.message: Publishing waits until every question is complete: {problem}
problem.surveyIncomplete.note: problem: the first thing to fix, one of the survey problems above (Write the question.)

problem.surveyType.message: Pick a type for every question: single choice, multiple choice, 0–10 scale, emoji scale, short or long text.
problem.surveyType.note: the question types as the survey builder names them

problem.surveyClosePassed: The closing date has passed. Pick a later date, or close the survey by hand.
problem.surveyNotPublished: This survey isn't published yet, so there's nothing to close.
problem.surveyCloseFuture: Pick a closing date in the future, or close the survey by hand.

label.untitledSurvey.note: a new survey's name until its author gives one; it stays in the language it was created in

label.surveyThanks.note: a new survey's thank-you text, which its author can rewrite: the survey's page shows it to the people who answer

label.noTier.note: the poll report's breakdown by engagement tier: contacts not in a tier yet

label.languageNotSet.note: the poll report's breakdown by language: contacts without a language

tier.active.note: an engagement tier, in the poll report's breakdown
